title: Analytics & Mastery Dashboard
description: Read your progress, compare groups, and identify recurring confusions.

steps.title: Core Mastery & Accuracy Metrics
steps.description: Total Attempts includes assisted guesses. Accuracy and mastery use only unassisted attempts; mastery requires at least 90% accuracy over at least five unassisted attempts. A dash means no unassisted attempts in the selected period. Streak records cover all time.

steps.title: Choose a Time Period
steps.description: Choose a period for accuracy, mastery, group comparisons, and confused pairs. Species encountered and streak records remain all-time measures. Returning to Dashboard after practice refreshes the results.

steps.title: Read Your Accuracy Trend
steps.description: The solid line shows a smoothed trend in unassisted accuracy; the dashed line is the average for the selected period. Trend smoothing controls how quickly the line responds to recent attempts. Use the slider or zoom to inspect a section.

steps.title: Compare Accuracy by Group
steps.description: Choose species, genus, family, or order in Group by. The table starts with practice priorities; sort accuracy or attempt counts to compare strengths. Small samples are less reliable. Use the table pagination to see more groups. Names follow your selected language.

steps.title: Recognize Recurring Confusions
steps.description: Compare the observation’s recorded taxon with your guess and how often you confused them. Scientific names appear beneath vernacular names when different. These counts include assisted mistakes.
